title: Ten Cups and a Nut
lines: Meg sets ten cups on a mat.
Meg tips a nut in a cup.
Meg taps the cups. "Get it, Ben!"
Ben taps a big cup. Not in it.
Ben taps a tan cup. Not it!
Ben taps the tin cup and gets the nut!
Meg nods. Ben gets to tip the nut in.
Meg taps the cups, and Meg gets it!

questions.ask: How many cups did Meg set on the mat?
questions.listenFor: Ten. It is in the first line. If your child is not sure, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: Which cup had the nut in it?
questions.listenFor: The tin cup. Line six says it. If they say "the last one," ask them to find the line that names it.

questions.ask: What did Ben tap first? What did he tap after that?
questions.listenFor: The big cup, then the tan cup, then the tin cup. Lines four to six hold the order.
